H-H1.rule_text: pass: both single models, all required seeds: c closer (log area) to the training size than to ind AND CI of every untrained size excludes 1 toward the training size. fail ('가운데 압축'): both models, all required seeds: c closer to ind than to the training size. else not_evaluable.

1.center_null_reason: a size has no valid mean ratio
1.reason: c is null: a size has no valid mean ratio

0.center_null_reason: ratio does not cross 1 on the grid (all sizes above 1)
0.reason: c is null: ratio does not cross 1 on the grid (all sizes above 1)

1.center_null_reason: ratio does not cross 1 on the grid (all sizes above 1)
1.reason: c is null: ratio does not cross 1 on the grid (all sizes above 1)

H-H2.rule_text: per mix distribution: pass if all (mix seed, baseline seed) pairs have mix_slope - baseline_slope >= gain; fail if all pairs |diff| < gain; else not_evaluable. No mean comparison.
